headline: Priya can distinguish visibility, focus, event actions, and native syncing colors before installing the extension.
overview: A live product-level walk for Calendar Clarity, framed around Priya Shah's actual decision rather than a list of routes.
targetAudience: Has a calendar full of meetings, solo blocks, tentative holds, and follow-ups. She wants the important commitments to stand out without moving to a new calendar app.

steps.title: The same calendar, with less visual competition
steps.description: Before and after states explain the product without asking Priya to abandon Google Calendar or create another account.
steps.screenshotAlt: Calendar Clarity hero and calmer calendar promise

steps.title: Four jobs are kept separate
steps.description: Visibility, focus, event actions, and colors are presented as distinct tools so Priya can evaluate the part she actually needs.

steps.title: Visibility dims noise without hiding events
steps.description: Solo, external, declined, and tentative events recede but remain present, preserving awareness without equal visual weight.

steps.title: Focus happens inside the event context
steps.description: The timer, ambient sounds, and Zen mode keep the work session attached to the calendar block that justified it.

steps.title: Colors are native, named, and portable
steps.description: AI grouping remains optional, while saved colors use Google's own event colors so they survive on mobile and other devices.

keyFeatures: Run a focus timer with Zen mode
